Package index

Main functions

run_entropy()
Estimate gene expression entropy on a Seurat object
run_entropy_h5ad()
Estimate gene expression entropy directly from an AnnData (.h5ad) file
add_entropy_score()
Add mean entropy scores for gene sets to a Seurat object
entropy_density_diagnostic()
Diagnose whether entropy is associated with neighbourhood density

Entropy estimators

calculate_entropy_for_cell()
Calculate entropy for a single cell based on its neighbors
calculate_entropy_for_cell_binary()
Calculate binary entropy for a single cell based on its neighbors
calculate_entropy_for_cell_binary_fast()
Calculate binary entropy for a single cell based on its neighbors (fast)
estimateur_bub_entropie_discrete()
Internal: Cached wrapper for the BUB discrete entropy estimator
get_bub_precomputed()
Internal: Get precomputed or fallback BUB entropy coefficients (R-only)
bub_opti()
Internal: BUB entropy estimator in pure R

Internal helpers

get_neighbors()
Get neighbor indices for a cell from a custom list or Seurat Neighbor object
prepare_chunks()
Internal: Prepare cell chunks for chunked entropy computation
prepare_chunks_emb()
Internal: split cells into compact chunks by k-means on the embedding
read_h5ad_inputs()
Internal: read the pieces we need out of an .h5ad file
rowCounts_CSC_cols()
Count row occurrences in selected columns of a sparse CSC matrix
validate_h5ad_matrix()
Internal: validate the h5ad expression matrix for the requested mode
